name: MATH-Vision
description: A benchmark of 3,040 high-quality visual mathematics problems sourced from real mathematical competitions, spanning 16 mathematical disciplines across 5 difficulty levels. Problems require integrating visual understanding (geometry figures, function graphs, statistical plots, physical diagrams) with mathematical reasoning. GPT-4V achieves only 23.98% while human performance reaches approximately 70%.
typical_sota_score: ~30–50% (frontier multimodal models as of 2025; GPT-4V: 23.98% at launch; humans ~70%)
reputation: Published at NeurIPS 2024; active leaderboard integrated into VLMEvalKit; bridges math reasoning and visual understanding evaluation; GPT-4V's 23.98% demonstrates major visual math gap
notes: NeurIPS 2024. 16 mathematical disciplines: algebra, arithmetic, combinatorics, geometry, logic, number theory, probability, statistics, and more. Five difficulty levels from elementary to competition. Problems sourced from AMC, AIME, MATHCOUNTS, and international olympiads. Active leaderboard integrated into VLMEvalKit. Complements MathVista (which uses existing datasets) by providing purpose-built competition problems.
